description: Making a decision-based game about space mission.
summary: Our project is an interactive space mission game inspired by NASA's Apollo Program. The game allows players to experience the challenges. The game aims to make learning about space exploration more engaging by combining education with interactive gameplay. By recreating elements of the Apollo missions in a fun and educational environment, players can develop problem-solving skills and gain a better appreciation of human achievements in science and technology.
details:
HOW IT WORK

  • Mission 1 : Build and launch the Spacecraft - The game allows players to complete four Apollo mission by building and launching a spacecraft, landing on the Moon, placing a flag and collecting scientific samples.
  • Mission 2 : Land on the Moon - Players learn about the spacecraft component and try to land safely on the Moon.
  • Mission 3 : Place the flag - Players complete the landing mission by placing a flag on the Moon.
  • Mission 4 : Collect Scientific Samples - Players choose the correct scientific instrument and collect samples from the Moon.

Benefits

  • Increases knowledge - Players can learn about the Apollo mission, spacecraft components and the Moon.
  • Improves Problem solving skills - Players need to make the right decision to complete each mission.

The intended impact of the project

  • Encourage students to learn more about science and space exploration.
  • Provide an interactive learning experience that combines education and entertainment.

Project creative

It combines education and entertainment through an interactive space exploration game. We use Visual Studio Code and java/html language.

Our consider

The education value, game design, difficult level and creativity to make sure the game is interesting.
